notes.title: Huge Cyber Attack & Data Loss || New Script Update.
notes.notes:
A few months back we suffered a cyber attack, most of the game data has been recovered, but we lost access to our google account and Youtube account permanently.

This is why it has been so quiet, I apologize to the fans here, it was a very stressful time. Luckily we managed to regain access to the steam account.

We are going to retrieve our videos from the old Youtube and migrate to a new one. This is why no new updates have been made.

The linked Design Document and full main script is still up, but can not be edited.
So a new version will be made and shared shortly.

But for the time being I made a new public google doc with writing progress beyond File #11.


Progress is still being made but please bear with us during the recovery process, once the new Youtube is made it will be shared with a new podcast.

ANONYMOUS || AGONY Main Script (Stratum Files)

notes.title: Script Update: Final Half of File #9 || #10 Added.
notes.notes:
The last half of File #9 || 10 has been added to the main script.
This part marks the last normal villain and the start of the end game game themes where the secret lore come into the light. Many and most questions are answered in this chapter in regards to the characters.

This was the most work any of the files took so far since it ended and tied up the initial themes and bled into the ending ones hinted at since the very first Episode.

There are only two more Episodes to finalize writing. Stay tuned for the future updates.

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V3lynNbg3rKRXD67SQJKjun90ZGmg2z41Soayi8QopE/edit?usp=sharing

Lastly, select vocal songs from the OST were uploaded to our official Youtube account!

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJ6DHwp-A8SwgCs1pw3AwPbYVh1oSx_5n

notes.title: Main Script update - First half of File #9 || #10
notes.notes:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V3lynNbg3rKRXD67SQJKjun90ZGmg2z41Soayi8QopE/edit?usp=sharing

The first half of File #9 || #10 Has been added to the main scripts doc. 


A longer time skip was  planned, but due to financial restraints and the desire to keep the same artist out of respect, a decision to create end-game cast characters took priority over updating previously drawn characters. I actually ended up liking this decision more. The same character development is present with a better feeling of continuity. 

That being said, these characters are planned to grow up and re-appear.  One time, one first time and final time, so the original scene of File #9 || #10  has been deleted with the final first half. 

I wanted to be completely done by January.  But I know game design requires tough calls,  I choose to maintain the story in its intended integrity as far as I can push, 

Stay updated guys!

notes.title: Version 2.0 Update Released - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The patch is now live adding the following listed below!
This is the first time I've released a patch, so if there are ANY errors please let us know immediately. 
The new version should of uploaded correctly if Steam Achievements are unlocking! 


-Implemented Steam Achievements.

-Player named net persona now displays in some chats correctly.

-Save option now opens right before the Stealth Task on Day #1

-New Save point in town that is literally un-missable.

-Night #1 church street repaired.

-Church Priest and daily dialogue is added. (Thanks Mandalore)

-Hospital side cast cameo is added in the church on Day #3.

-Striker's first FreeFlow chat is fixed.

-Fiona's FreeFlow chat about her icon, has it's second glitched part now added to the initial chat (One of my personal favorites, glad you guys can now see it!)

-The NPC in ZebraTec on Night #1 is fixed. Leading to a hidden event.

-The "Diavolo Girl" quest on day #3 can activate and be completed leading to a hidden end game email with secret information. 

Haze's finalized opening video and credits are not updated yet and will be at a later time.

notes.title: November 25th Patch Notes.
notes.notes:
File #1 uses an old engine and unfortunately some bugs are unfixable due to the complex internal scripts. But the FreeFlow chat crashes and level graphic errors will be repaired.  Also the Steam Achievements will be patched in.

Since proper understanding of the dual themed story requires players see File #2 it will release early.

Due to voice actor schedules it may only have partial voice acting. With the full voice work patching in when the cast records the full game at once.

File #3 - #13 will be sold as a single DLC.

Please consider each prior release as a demo for each protagonist.

notes.title: Game Release/Known Bugs
notes.notes:
For all of you who have waited so long for this game to release, we appreciate your astounding patience, and your incredible support for the game!  Thank you!  We hope you enjoy the game, be sure to save at home and Wireless Joy (in Inner Paradise)!  

There are a few known issues we're going to list here, we're going to try to fix them at some point soon, if we can.

Known/Potential Bugs

The texts you get on the way back home might crash the game, might want to wait until you save at the home computer first.

Same with the computer emails.  There's a couple that will crash the game, one that triggers a pop-up link.  Again, save first before reading. 

When you talk to Hail at the Endless Rhythm music store, and ask her how to be featured as an artist, it's possible when she opens the link in your browser, it could crash the game.  Save at Wireless Joy beforehand. 

In the Freeflow chat program, your game might freeze if you try to talk to the offline users, but also RHS6 even when he's online, outside of cutscenes.

We'll also be posting this in the forum as a separate topic, so if you find any bugs, please report to us ASAP with your computer specs.  Thanks!  Have fun, everyone!
